sampling: Paired iid uniform draws inside declared parameter ranges. Not experimental confidence intervals. No aggregate score across conflicting objectives.
scope_note: Twenty-five selected parameters retain the preceding retention-site draws exactly. Reverse-carbonation factor is fixed at one, with permeability, pore radius, condensation factor, evaporation A/E and staged atmosphere also fixed. No reverse-kinetics or atmosphere-range robustness follows. Eight paired samples and unqualified physical/process cases yield exploratory rankings only; no measured material or qualified-process optimization.
